**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Stop Search Dialog)**

### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Standard Windows 11 chrome (Title bar, Taskbar).
*   **Main App Regions (Background):**
    *   **Header/Toolbar:** [0, 0] to [1024, 115]. Contains App Title, Navigation, View toggles, Filter, and Search.
    *   **Sidebar (Tree):** [0, 116] to [230, 860]. Shows "Windows (C:)", "File Path Lost", etc.
    *   **Main Content (List):** [231, 116] to [794, 860]. File list with columns (Name, Date Modified, Type).
    *   **Preview Pane:** [795, 116] to [1024, 860]. Shows folder icon and metadata for selected item.
    *   **Status Bar (Bottom Strip):** [0, 810] to [1024, 942]. Full-width scanning progress area.
*   **Modal Dialog (Foreground - Focus):**
    *   **Container:** Centered. Approx bounds: **[232, 165] to [752, 655]**.
    *   **Internal Grid:**
        *   **Header Icon:** Centered, top.
        *   **Title Text:** Centered below icon.
        *   **Stats Row:** Two equal-width columns side-by-side.
        *   **Info Text:** Full width, centered/left-aligned block.
        *   **Action Footer:** Two buttons, right-aligned (or centered with gap).

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
**Dialog:**
*   `Stop Searching for Lost Data?` (Title)
*   `1139164` (Stat Value 1)
*   `Files found` (Stat Label 1)
*   `00:02:38` (Stat Value 2)
*   `Used time` (Stat Label 2)
*   `Remaining data can be rescanned and recovered anytime later, but continuing now save you time.` (Body text)
*   `Stop` (Button Label)
*   `Continue` (Button Label)

**Background (Status Bar):**
*   `Searching: ...00040000000A9FB273B246C9\Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.resources.dll`
*   `22%` (Gauge)
*   `Advanced Scanning , Files Found: 1139164 (146.29 GB)`
*   `Remaining time: 09m59s`
*   `Reading sector: 68001792/313413598`
*   `Recover All ...`

**Background (Preview Pane):**
*   `actionarchivecache`
*   `Open`
*   `Size`
*   `7.29 MB`
*   `Date Modified`
*   `10/7/2026 11:30 PM`
*   `Path`
*   `C:\`

### 3. COLOR
*   **Dialog Background:** `#FFFFFF` (White).
*   **App Background (Dimmed):** Overlay approx `#FFFFFF` at 40-50% opacity (darkening effect).
*   **Primary Accent (Blue):** `#1677FF` (Estimate - "Continue" button, "Recover All" button, Links).
*   **Destructive/Accent (Red/Pink):** `#FFEBE6` (Bg of Stop btn), `#CF1322` or similar dark red (Text of Stop btn).
*   **Text Primary:** `#1F1F1F` (Almost black).
*   **Text Secondary:** `#666666` or `#8C8C8C` (Labels like "Files found", "Size").
*   **Border/Lines:** `#E5E5E5` or `#D9D9D9`.
*   **Status Bar Background:** Light blue-grey tint, possibly `#F0F5FF` or `#E6F7FF`.

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Dialog Title:** Sans-Serif (Segoe UI/Inter), ~16px-18px, **Bold** (600+).
*   **Stat Values (`1139164`):** Sans-Serif, ~28px-32px, **Bold**, Monospaced or Tabular nums.
*   **Stat Labels (`Files found`):** Sans-Serif, ~12px-13px, Regular (400), Grey.
*   **Body Text:** Sans-Serif, ~13px-14px, Regular (400), Dark Grey.
*   **Buttons:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Medium (500).

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Dialog Dimensions:** Width ~520px, Height ~490px.
*   **Border Radius (Dialog):** ~8px.
*   **Shadow (Dialog):** Soft drop shadow, blur ~20px, offset Y ~10px, color Black/Alpha 15%.
*   **Padding (Dialog Internal):** ~32px-40px on all sides.
*   **Buttons:**
    *   Height: ~36px-40px.
    *   Width: ~100px-120px.
    *   Gap between buttons: ~12px.
    *   Border Radius: ~4px-6px.
*   **Stats Container:** Light grey background `#FAFAFA`, Border Radius ~8px, Padding ~20px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Modal Dialog:** State = **Open / Active**. Blocks interaction with main window.
*   **Button "Stop":**
    *   Type: Button.
    *   Style: Ghost/Light fill (Pink bg, Red text).
    *   State: Normal (Hover not visible, but implied clickable).
*   **Button "Continue":**
    *   Type: Button.
    *   Style: Primary Fill (Blue bg, White text).
    *   State: Normal / Default Action.
*   **Close 'X' (Dialog):**
    *   Type: IconButton.
    *   Location: Top-Right corner of dialog.
    *   State: Normal.
*   **Background Controls (Disabled/Inactive due to modal):**
    *   TreeView items (Collapsed/Expanded states visible but unclickable).
    *   ListView items (Checkboxes, File icons).
    *   Progress Bar/Circular Gauge (Active state in background).

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Vector, "Fluent" or modern Windows style.
*   **Dialog Header Icon:** Illustrative. A grey folder/basket containing colorful file icons (Blue doc, Purple music, Red image) with a large Yellow/Gold **Pause** symbol (two vertical bars) overlaid in a circle. Size: ~64x64px or 80x80px.
*   **Close Icon:** Simple 'X' outline.
*   **Background Icons:**
    *   **Navigation:** Home, Back, Forward, Up arrow.
    *   **View:** List view, Filter funnel.
    *   **Tree:** Folder icons (Yellow), Drive icon (C:).
    *   **List:** Checkboxes (square), Folder icons.
    *   **Status Bar:** Pause (||), Stop (Square), Clock/History icon.

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Interrupted Processing / Confirmation Request**.
*   **Context:** The application is actively performing an "Advanced Scanning" operation (visible in background status bar: 22% complete). A modal dialog has appeared asking the user to confirm if they want to **Stop** the scan or **Continue** it.
*   **Motion Cues:** None explicitly frozen, but the background implies active progress (scanning sectors) which is currently paused by the modal.

### Specific Focus Area Details:
*   **Circular % Gauge:**
    *   Location: Bottom Left of Status Bar.
    *   Size: Approx 50x50px diameter.
    *   Color: Blue stroke (`#1677FF`) on light track.
    *   Label: "22%" centered inside.
*   **Files Found Counter:**
    *   Location: Status Bar center-left.
    *   Text: `Files Found: 1139164 (146.29 GB)`
*   **Elapsed Time:**
    *   Location: Inside Modal (Right stat box).
    *   Value: `00:02:38`
*   **Status Line Text:**
    *   Location: Thin blue strip above main status bar.
    *   Content: Current file being scanned path.
*   **Searching Strip:**
    *   Location: Bottom ~130px of window.
    *   Full Width: Yes.
    *   Contents: Current file path (left), Progress stats (center), Recover button (right).
*   **Pause/Stop Buttons:**
    *   Location: Bottom left, next to the 22% gauge.
    *   Icons: `||` (Pause) and `■` (Stop). No text labels visible, just icons.
*   **Tree/List/Preview Panes:**
    *   Visible behind modal overlay (dimmed).
    *   Tree shows "Windows (C:)" expanded.
    *   List shows folders "Julia", "mingw32".
    *   Preview shows details for "actionarchivecache".
*   **Dialog Stats:**
    *   Left Box: `1139164` Files found.
    *   Right Box: `00:02:38` Used time.
*   **Dialog Buttons:**
    *   `Stop` (Left/Center), `Continue` (Right/Center).
